_about: French texts of the reports: project summary (set_project.py), Mixxx export report (mixxx_export.py), Playlist / Mixxx Export / Mastering / Band Analysis report headers and track flags (set_builder.py, charts.py), and the stored English warnings of the transition FX (transition_fx.py, fx_render.py) translated when shown. Keys are the English texts of the code, values their translation; keep every {placeholder} (with its format, e.g. {bpm:.0f}) unchanged. DJ jargon stays English (set list, cue, FX, sample, BPM, pre-master, playlist, Auto DJ, Mixxx).
